name: Weekly Participation Admin Snapshot
description: Create one workflow-backed provisional Participation Steward admin snapshot per ISO week.

instructionConfig.prompt:
Use prism-scheduled-task-runner and change-request-ops. Create at most one weekly change-board request per UTC ISO week for this task.

Task key: weekly-participation-admin-snapshot
Workflow key: weekly-participation-admin-snapshot
Checkpoint file: /data/custom/weekly-request-checkpoints/weekly-participation-admin-snapshot.json

Idempotency rules:
1. Compute the current UTC ISO week key in YYYY-Www format.
2. Read the checkpoint if it exists.
3. If checkpoint.week_key matches and checkpoint.last_created_request_id is present, do not create another request. Return a skipped result with the request ID and number.
4. Otherwise create exactly one change-board request. Update the checkpoint only after successful creation.

Create the request with workflowKey `weekly-participation-admin-snapshot`, no targetAppId, requestType `ops`, priority `normal`, status `submitted`, and source `scheduled-task`. Use title `Weekly Participation Admin Snapshot - <YYYY-Www>` and description `Collect the current Hall Monitor Participation Steward evidence, calculate the 20/60/70 provisional cycle scores, resolve members by Gnosis wallet, and publish the admin-only snapshot to Participation. This request must not create a DAO proposal, issue shares, or change entitlements.`

Return compact JSON only with created/skipped, week_key, requestNumber, id, workflowKey, and status. Do not ask follow-up questions.
